## Checklist

- [ ] `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e` pass
- [ ] Exactly one label set: `release:major`, `release:minor`, `release:hotfix` or `release:none`
- [ ] Version not changed by hand
